title.zh-TW: 好友交易手續費減免 5%（以註冊頁顯示為準）
title.en: 5% trading-fee reduction for the invited friend (as shown on the sign-up page)

text.zh-TW: 2026-10-24 查看註冊頁時顯示「推薦你使用Pionex 交易手續費減免5%」；實際比例由邀請人設定，以註冊頁與官方公告為準。
text.en: The sign-up page showed a 5% trading-fee reduction on 2026-10-24; the referrer sets the actual rate, so follow the sign-up page and the official announcements.

title.zh-TW: 邀請人可獲交易手續費返傭（最高 20%）
title.en: The referrer can earn a commission on trading fees (up to 20%)

text.zh-TW: 這是邀請人（本頁提供者）的回饋，不是好友的優惠。最高 20% 取自平台分享文案，計算基礎取自官方推薦計畫規則；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: The referrer's reward, not the friend's. The 20% cap is from the share text, the fee basis from official rules; actual terms follow official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（邀請碼 0FfHG12tqCh 已包含在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (invite code 0FfHG12tqCh is already part of it).

steps.zh-TW: 確認註冊頁的推薦碼（邀請碼）欄位已帶入 0FfHG12tqCh（開頭是數字 0，請依原樣含大小寫輸入）；若沒有，請手動輸入。
steps.en: Check that the referral code (invite code) field shows 0FfHG12tqCh (starts with the digit zero; enter it exactly as shown); if not, enter it manually.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊頁若有顯示手續費折扣比例（2026-10-24 查看時為 5%），請先確認內容再繼續。
steps.en: If the sign-up page shows a trading-fee discount rate (5% when checked on 2026-10-24), read it before you continue.

steps.zh-TW: 依平台規定完成註冊與身分驗證，並先確認所在地可以使用。
steps.en: Complete registration and identity verification as the platform requires, and check first that the service is available where you live.

intro.zh-TW: 台灣證期局警示（公會網站登載）：未依公司法登記，不得在台提供服務或招攬。註冊前請先閱讀說明。
intro.en: Taiwan SFB warning (association site): not registered under the Company Act; may not serve or solicit in Taiwan. Read the notes first.

description.zh-TW:
台灣監管提醒：中華民國虛擬通貨商業同業公會網站「警示專區」登載了派網（Pionex）的警示（發布日期 2024-01-05，通報單位：證期局證券商管理組）：派網並非依公司法登記，也未向金管會完成洗錢防制法令遵循聲明，不得在台提供虛擬通貨平台及交易業務，或向國人進行廣告等招攬；金管會建議國人不要使用其在台提供的服務，也避免轉帳到該公司提供的帳戶。這是公會網站的登載內容，本站未找到證期局另行發布的原始公告；證期局 2026-09-29 更新的虛擬資產服務事業名單也未列出派網。本站不表示派網在台灣合法或安全，註冊前請自行評估風險並確認所在地法規。

Pionex 派網是加密資產交易平台，主打內建交易機器人，同時提供現貨與合約交易，有網站與手機 App。這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結，邀請碼 0FfHG12tqCh 已包含在連結中；若註冊頁沒有帶入，請手動輸入。

平台分享文案宣稱：邀請人最高可獲得 20% 返傭，並可與好友共享傭金。官方推薦計畫規則則寫明：返傭按好友的交易手續費計算，邀請人可從返傭中分出一部分作為好友的手續費折扣，規則沒有訂出好友可得的具體數字。2026-10-24 查看時，註冊頁顯示交易手續費減免 5%，實際比例以註冊頁為準。實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Taiwan regulatory notice: the warning section of the Taiwan Virtual Asset Service Provider Association (中華民國虛擬通貨商業同業公會) website lists a warning about Pionex (dated 2024-01-05; reporting unit: Securities Firms Management Division of the Securities and Futures Bureau, SFB). It says Pionex is not registered under the Company Act and has not completed the anti-money-laundering compliance declaration, so it may not provide virtual-currency platform and trading services in Taiwan or solicit people in Taiwan through advertising or similar marketing. The Financial Supervisory Commission advises people not to use Pionex’s services in Taiwan and to avoid transferring money to accounts it provides. This is the association website’s listing, and this site has not found a separate original SFB notice. Pionex is also not on the SFB list of virtual asset service providers updated on 2026-09-29. This site does not say Pionex is legal or safe in Taiwan; assess the risk yourself and check your local regulations before you register.

Pionex is a crypto-asset trading platform whose main feature is built-in trading bots, offered alongside spot and futures trading on a website and mobile apps. This is the referrer’s personal invite link, and the invite code 0FfHG12tqCh is already part of it; if the sign-up page does not fill it in, enter it manually.

The platform’s share text claims that the referrer can earn up to 20% commission and can share commission with friends. The official referral program rules state that the commission is based on the friend’s trading fees and that the referrer can set aside part of the rebate rate as the friend’s trading-fee discount; the rules do not fix an amount for the friend. When checked on 2026-10-24 the sign-up page showed a 5% trading-fee reduction, and the page’s own rate prevails. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
邀請碼 0FfHG12tqCh 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（開頭是數字 0）。分享文案的「最高享 20% 返傭」指邀請人可獲得好友交易手續費的一部分，不是好友的優惠。依官方推薦計畫規則，現貨為 20%、合約為 15%，且好友需註冊並入金至少 100 USDT、於註冊後 30 個自然日內完成首次入金與交易才會計算（繁中規則頁另載明非 KOL 邀請人僅計算好友註冊後 365 個自然日內的交易，英文規則頁未提），另有 VIP 等級與特定商品的例外。分享文案另附快速邀請連結（主機 accounts.pionex.com，邀請碼相同），本頁使用 www.pionex.com 的邀請連結。

台灣監管提醒（查閱於 2026-10-25）：中華民國虛擬通貨商業同業公會網站（twvasp.org.tw）的警示專區列有派網（Pionex），發布日期 2024-01-05（民國 113.01.05），通報單位為證期局（金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局）證券商管理組。條目寫明：派網並非依公司法登記，也未向金管會完成洗錢防制法令遵循聲明，不得在台提供虛擬通貨平台及交易業務，或向國人進行廣告等招攬；金管會建議國人不要使用其在台提供的服務，也避免轉帳到該公司提供的帳戶。證期局網站的投資警示與宣導頁（2026-10-01 更新）有連到公會的警示專區，但本站未找到證期局另行發布的派網原始公告，請視為轉載資料。證期局公布的虛擬資產服務事業名單（2026-09-29 更新）未列出派網。以上不代表派網在台灣合法或安全，是否使用請自行評估並確認所在地法規。

平台免責聲明表示，其可能未在使用者所在地取得提供服務的許可，且若業務失敗，資金追償可能受限。各來源對派網營運主體的說法不一，本站不對法律主體作任何說明。請以官方最新公告為準。
notes.en:
Invite code 0FfHG12tqCh is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown (it starts with the digit zero). The “up to 20% commission” in the share text is the part of the friend's trading fees that the referrer can receive; it is not a perk for the friend. Under the official referral program rules the rate is 20% for spot and 15% for futures, and it counts only if the friend registers, deposits at least 100 USDT and makes a first deposit and trade within 30 calendar days of registering (the zh-TW rules page also limits non-KOL referrers to trades within 365 calendar days of the friend registering; the English rules page does not mention this), with exceptions for VIP levels and certain products. The share text also gives a quick invite link (host accounts.pionex.com, same code); this page uses the www.pionex.com invite link.

Taiwan regulatory notice (checked on 2026-10-25): the warning section of the Taiwan Virtual Asset Service Provider Association (中華民國虛擬通貨商業同業公會) website (twvasp.org.tw) lists Pionex with a publication date of 2024-01-05 (113.01.05 in the ROC calendar) and the Securities Firms Management Division of the Securities and Futures Bureau (SFB) of the Financial Supervisory Commission as the reporting unit. The entry says Pionex is not registered under the Company Act and has not completed the anti-money-laundering compliance declaration, so it may not provide virtual-currency platform and trading services in Taiwan or solicit people in Taiwan through advertising or similar marketing; the Financial Supervisory Commission advises people not to use Pionex’s services in Taiwan and to avoid transferring money to accounts it provides. The SFB website’s investor warnings page (updated 2026-10-01) links to the association’s warning section, but this site has not found a separate original SFB notice about Pionex, so treat this as reproduced information. Pionex does not appear on the SFB’s list of virtual asset service providers (updated 2026-09-29). None of this means Pionex is legal or safe in Taiwan; assess the risk yourself and check your local regulations before you use the platform.

Pionex’s own disclaimer says it may not hold a license to offer services where you live and that recovering funds could be limited if its business fails. Sources differ on which entity operates Pionex, so this site makes no claim about the legal entity. Follow the latest official announcements.

q.zh-TW: Pionex 派網的邀請碼是多少？
q.en: What is the Pionex invite code?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼是 0FfHG12tqCh（開頭是數字 0），已包含在本頁的邀請連結中。若註冊頁的推薦碼（邀請碼）欄位沒有帶入，請依原樣手動輸入。
a.en: The invite code is 0FfHG12tqCh (it starts with the digit zero) and is already part of the invite link on this page. If the referral code (invite code) field on the sign-up page is empty, enter it exactly as shown.

q.zh-TW: 使用邀請碼註冊，好友可以得到什麼？
q.en: What does a friend get by signing up with the invite code?

a.zh-TW: 註冊頁（2026-10-24 查看）顯示好友可享交易手續費減免 5%。平台分享文案提到邀請人可與好友共享傭金；依官方推薦計畫規則，邀請人可把部分返傭比例分給好友，作為交易手續費折扣，實際比例由邀請人設定，請以註冊頁顯示與官方公告為準。
a.en: The sign-up page (checked on 2026-10-24) showed a 5% trading-fee reduction for the invited friend. The platform’s share text says the referrer can share commission with friends; under the official referral program rules the referrer can pass part of the rebate rate to the friend as a trading-fee discount, and the referrer sets the actual rate, so follow what the sign-up page shows and the official announcements.

q.zh-TW: Pionex 派網在台灣可以使用嗎？
q.en: Can I use Pionex in Taiwan?

a.zh-TW: 台灣證期局有警示：公會網站登載（2024-01-05）指派網未依公司法登記、未完成洗錢防制法令遵循聲明，不得在台提供服務或招攬。證期局 2026-09-29 更新的名單未列出派網，派網自己的免責聲明也說，可能未在你的所在地取得服務許可。本站不表示在台灣使用合法或安全，請自行評估並確認當地法規。
a.en: The Taiwan SFB has a warning, listed on an industry association website (2024-01-05): Pionex is not registered under the Company Act, has not completed the anti-money-laundering declaration, and may not provide services in Taiwan or solicit people there. It is not on the SFB list updated on 2026-09-29, and Pionex’s own disclaimer says it may not hold a license where you live. This site does not say the service is legal or safe in Taiwan; check local rules yourself.
